title: MULTITASK PROMPTED TRAINING ENABLES ZERO-SHOT TASK GENERALIZATION
measurement_description: The paper evaluates model knowledge on the 'Hindu Knowledge' task from the BIG-bench benchmark. It also includes 'Religion' as a category for stereotype/bias identification in the SUPER-GLUE AXG dataset, although specific results for this category are not reported.
findings: On the Hindu Knowledge task from the BIG-bench benchmark, multitask prompted training improved performance over baselines. The T5-LM (11B) baseline scored 32.00%. The T0 model (11B) scored 36.00%, T0+ (11B) scored 38.29%, and T0++ (11B) scored 40.00%. The results demonstrate that performance on this knowledge-based task increased as the model was trained on a larger mixture of multitask datasets.
